rules: Every case asserts RouteFamily, RouteIntent, ExecutionMode, retrieval policy, exact allowed_tools, and LearningStyleHint where applicable.
The harness performs no LLM calls; ambiguous learning requests use deterministic rules and the bounded LearningAnswer path.
Cases marked web_search pass web_search=True into QueryPipeline preparation.
unexpected_rag_count means a disallowed learning_answer execution mode.
Non-TOOL_AGENT cases require an empty allowed_tools tuple.
